root_cause: The test failed due to a read timeout when attempting to connect to the TMDB API
suggested_fix: Increase the read timeout value or optimize the test to reduce the time it takes to receive a response from the API
explanation: The error message indicates a ReadTimeout exception, which occurs when the API takes longer than the specified timeout to respond. This could be due to network issues, high server load, or an inefficient test. Increasing the timeout or optimizing the test can help resolve the issue
